responsibility: Implements the RTL Swing Modulo Scheduling pass for software pipelining countable loops. It builds and schedules dependence-graph nodes under an initiation interval using resource constraints from the DFA scheduler interface, maintains partial schedules and row/cycle placement logic, computes stage counts and schedule rotations, and, after a successful schedule, supports the generation of prologue/kernel/epilogue structure and modulo variable expansion needed for overlapping iterations. It also defines the sms RTL pass entry point that runs the scheduler when modulo scheduling is enabled.
